load_lora_adapter: load a LoRA adapter weights from a Hugging Face model repo and fuse them into the diffusion model
unload_lora_adapter: unload the currently loaded LoRA adapter weights and textual embeddings to revert to the base model
check_if_lora: check if a Hugging Face model repo contains valid LoRA weight files or LoRA tags
get_lora_weight_name: find and return the correct LoRA weight filename from a model repo's sibling files
load_textual_embeddings: load pivotal tuning textual inversion embeddings from a LoRA adapter into the text encoders
